title: DrawingTitleBlock
description: Structured fields extracted from a construction drawing sheet's title block, produced by the vision-language extraction step. All fields except 'confidence' are nullable because title blocks are frequently incomplete, hand-annotated, or partially illegible.

drawing_number.description: The drawing/sheet number exactly as printed, e.g. 'C-101' or 'MEP-DWG-0042-REV-B'. Null if not confidently legible.

sheet_title.description: The descriptive title of the sheet, e.g. 'ROAD LAYOUT PLAN - SECTOR 4'. Null if not confidently legible.

revision.description: The revision code or letter/number shown in the title block, e.g. 'B', 'P02', '3'. Null if not shown.

issue_date.description: The issue/print date as printed on the drawing, kept as free text (drawings rarely use strict ISO-8601 formatting, e.g. '12/03/2025' or 'MAR 2025'). Null if not shown.

discipline.description: The engineering discipline this sheet belongs to. One of: civil, structural, mep, architectural, landscape, other. Null if it cannot be determined.

scale_text.description: The scale as printed in the title block or near it, verbatim, e.g. '1:100', '1/4"=1\'-0"', 'NTS', 'AS SHOWN'. Null if no scale text is visible.

project_name.description: The overall project name shown in the title block, e.g. 'AL BARSHA SOUTH INFRASTRUCTURE PACKAGE 2'. Null if not shown.

client_name.description: The client/employer name shown in the title block. Null if not shown.

confidence.description: The model's own confidence in the overall extraction quality across all fields, from 0 (no reliable fields extracted) to 1 (all fields extracted with high certainty).
